rules.statement: A GitHub Actions workflow whose job is a required merge check must trigger on every pull request and on `merge_group` without trigger-level `paths`/`paths-ignore` filters, deciding inside a detection job whether the real work runs so that a skipped job still reports success.
rules.why: A path-filtered workflow never reports on pull requests outside its paths, leaving the required check pending and blocking the merge; the merge queue also needs the check on `merge_group` to merge anything.
rules.check: In a workflow file diff that adds or changes a gating workflow, look for `paths`/`paths-ignore` under `on.pull_request` or `on.push`, or a missing `merge_group` trigger; the change-detection logic should be in a job (for example, a detect-changes job whose outputs gate later jobs with `if:`).
